plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: LLM Wiki -- a persistent, compounding knowledge base in a local markdown vault, built and maintained from Claude Code via per-operation commands. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.

plugins.name: python-dev
plugins.description: Python development workflow: subagents that run tests + lint, write tests, and do root-cause debugging, plus a run-tests skill that drives the runner.

plugins.name: guided-learning
plugins.description: A hands-on teaching posture for learning any procedural system by operating it yourself, with Claude as lab instructor.

plugins.name: format
plugins.description: Format files with a conform.nvim/mason-style toolchain (isort/ruff/prettier/shfmt/stylua/taplo/latexindent/...). Defaults to git-changed files; respects repo-local formatter config.

plugins.name: conventional-commit-message
plugins.description: Draft a Conventional Commits message from the conversation's changed files and current git state; infers type/scope from repo history and never commits or pushes.

plugins.name: coordination-ledger
plugins.description: Cross-repo coordination ledger -- a local, never-pushed issue tracker for repos under a common parent (e.g. paper + codebase). A Python program owns a JSON index; per-operation commands (init, register, open, reply, check) are thin wrappers (no hooks); parties registered incrementally at any relative path (incl. submodules); zero footprint in the party repos.
